_help: Current-season stats for draft prospects outside the OHL, WHL, QMJHL and USHL feeds. Each player points at an open stats page that is read at every build (kind chn = College Hockey News team page, ntdp = USA Hockey NTDP stats page). Add a player with team, league, kind and url; or give fixed numbers with kind manual (gp, g, a, p, source, asOf). Sites that block automated requests (KHL, Swiss NL, Liiga, DEL, Elite Prospects) can't be read.
